failure: Older queued upload/favorite entries survived successful later deletion and could replay after it.
beforeFix: Queue regression failed: successful delete acknowledged only the delete, leaving upload and favorite entries.
changes: Removal queues its durable action in the same state update as optimistic local removal and uses the serialized sync pipeline
Linear reverse queue pass makes later deletion supersede older garment uploads, favorites and duplicate deletes
Superseded entries are acknowledged only when deletion succeeds
Direct insert settlement for an already removed local garment queues another idempotent removal instead of publishing or queueing creation
regressions: Failed deletion keeps all related actions
Successful deletion acknowledges related obsolete mutations without uploading them
Late successful insert after initial deletion acknowledgement queues removal
Late insert error/lost acknowledgement queues removal
Failure after account switch cannot queue work into next account
deployment: Client source only; no production mutations/provider calls
limits: Native network races not yet exercised

An app killed after a server accepts an in-flight insert and before the compensating delete is persisted is not proven safe; server tombstones or durable request protocol would be needed for that guarantee
